cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Outsmart the Room
cards.instruction: Turn every clue, deduction, and secret into a contest you must solve or control first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll finish this murder quiz now. I've put 'the gardener' above your answer on the board.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine, one answer on the slip. But who said it first?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My chalk reached the board first. I'll write both our names; mine goes on top.
